lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, approximately circular clusters arranged in quasi-vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a grid-like spatial distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity (light grey) intersecting with the circular blobs at regular intervals, creating anchor nodes in a matrix pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from a high-intensity upper edge to a low-intensity shadow beneath.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the anterior margin and scattered sparsely across the medial surface of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, vertical, linear high-luminance mark resembling a healed scratch or scar is visible on the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dense school of small, low-luminance teleost fish clustered beneath the ventral-lateral region and around the pectoral fin.
